title: IAM user-team membership search: decode layer location
answers: Where is user-team membership search handled in IAM?
Where does the GetUserTeams endpoint build its response from search results?
body:
The IAM `/users/{name}/teams` Connect handler lives in pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/rest_user_team.go (UserTeamREST.Connect). It issues a ResourceSearchRequest filtered by user name, decodes rows via decodeUserTeamSearchRows, and projects them to iamv0alpha1.GetUserTeamsUserTeam via buildItems — which either reads inline permission/external cells (legacy RESOURCE_TABLE adapter path) or fans out parallel team Gets (unified FIELD_VALUES path) bounded by userTeamsGetParallelism.
Pagination continue tokens are built from the normalized row's sortFields (resource.NewSearchContinueToken), not from the raw ResourceTableRow/ResourceSearchRow, so any change to row decoding must keep sortFields populated for both formats.
says: Where does the system process the list of teams a user belongs?
How are team results built and assembled for the teams listing?
Where can I modify how user team membership searches are processed?
